data.name: Ashqar
data.gender_notes: Ashqar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is passionate and enamored, a lover. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'ashq' which means 'love' or 'passion'. The name Ashqar carries the meaning “Lover, Enamored” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ashqar usually hope their child will grow to embody lover, enamored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are deeply in love with Allah, and strive to maintain their love and devotion to Him throughout their lives.
data.etymology: Ashqar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover, Enamored.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashqar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Ashqar
in_english.meaning: name that signifies absolute love and the feeling of poverty and weakness in love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ashqar is derived from the quadriliteral root شق-ر-ق-ش, meaning absolute love and the feeling of poverty and weakness in love. It is considered one of the beautiful names in Islam and is used in the Quran to describe the love of God and the feeling of poverty and weakness before Him. It is a manifestation of love in Islam and is used in naming Muslim children to signify absolute love and the feeling of poverty and weakness before God.
